ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that ingests transaction feeds, constructs dynamic transaction graph networks, and performs multi-step AML investigations with explainable audit trails.

ideas.title: BiomechCoach: Real-Time Edge AI Biomechanical Injury & Form Agent
